title: Critique: the no-self claim assumes a classical notion of self

statements.text: Zahavi argues that Metzinger concludes there are no selves only because he implicitly keeps a classical conception of the self as an unchanging, process-independent substance. The conclusion follows only if that definition were the only one, and the literature holds many competing definitions of self.

sources.quote: Metzinger himself, at least implicitly, remains committed to a rather classical conception of the self
this conclusion would only be warranted if Metzinger’s definition of the self were the only one available
